<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def ents(frame):
    out=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        out.append((n['color'],n['pixels'],min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
print("BEFORE:")

res = action(['RIGHT'])
print("AFTER RIGHT:")
for e in ents(current_frame): print(e)
print('result', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('executed_actions','board_changed','level_completed','done','score','state')})
</parameter>
</function>
